title: Solomahal
caption: Solomahal (V)
game_text: Deploy on your scout (except Luke). If scout (or starship they are aboard) was just targeted by a weapon, may place this Effect in Lost Pile to cancel that targeting.
lore: Veteran officer of the Old Republic who retired from active duty after the Clone Wars. Makes a living in the Outer Rim Territories passing on his scouting expertise.
